name: mob
description: Local assistant with Electron, AI SDK UI and OpenTUI.

scripts.test:web: bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/app typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && vitest run
scripts.test:tui: bun run --cwd apps/tui typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/tui test
scripts.test:docs: bun run --cwd apps/docs sync && bun run --cwd apps/docs test
scripts.test:dsh: bun run --cwd apps/dsh typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/dsh test
scripts.desktop: bun run build:cli && MOB_BINARY=$PWD/build/mob bun run --cwd apps/desktop start
scripts.test:desktop: bun run --cwd apps/desktop typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/desktop test
scripts.test:core: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd apps/mob typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/mob test
